artboards.title: Welcome

Also drawn as the auth 'Start here' map phone (hotspots 1 Create an account -> A2, 2 Sign in -> A22); the map also lists Wallet settings > Tier -> A17 and Me > Verification > Identity check -> A21. Design note: the map phone equals the flow's own first screen, which the bundle rule normally forbids; here the app opens on A1.

evidence: static screen; session state comes from WAWU ID tokens (POST /auth/refresh, wawu-id/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:36)

web.delta: Web entry is a marketing landing page with App Store/Play badges marked coming soon, not a one-screen welcome; copy differs and web never claims banking ('bank it all in one app').

facts_on_canvas: 'bank it all in one app' (implies a bank account per user)

artboards.title: Why you're here
artboards.what_it_shows: Account-type choice: 'I'm here to discover' (follow creators, buy their work, use the wallet) vs 'I want to earn' (sell content, take paid questions, host events. Free.). Continue.
data_needed: accountType enum user|creator persisted after registration

evidence: PATCH /api/hub/users/me {accountType} (wawu-backend/src/user-profile/dto/update-user-profile.dto.ts: accountType IsEnum(AccountType user|creator)); UserProfile.accountType in backend-models
WAWU ID register does NOT take an account type (RegisterDto) - type lives only in the Hub
backend.gap: Account type is not part of WAWU ID registration; mobile must call WAWU ID register then Hub PATCH /users/me. Creator choice provisions a Flutterwave wallet (user-profile.service.ts:283); 'discover' accounts get no wallet today although the card says 'use the wallet'.

web.delta: Same two-card choice. Web copy: discover = browse/unlock/message/join/shop, 'No charge'; earn = upload, paid DMs, host communities, list services, 'keep 85%'. Web does not promise a wallet to discover accounts and does not say 'host events'.

facts_on_canvas: 'I want to earn ... Free.' (earning account costs nothing)
conflicts: 'I want to earn: ... host events' offered at sign-up vs current rule that hosting an event is VERIFIED-ONLY (B3).
'I'm here to discover: ... use the wallet' vs current wallet = creator-only Flutterwave payout subaccount.

evidence: WAWU ID POST /auth/register (wawu-id/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:24; RegisterDto wawu-id/src/auth/dto/register.dto.ts accepts fullName|firstName/middleName/lastName, email, phone, dialCode, country, state, gender, occupation, password; NO bvn, NO dateOfBirth, NO accountType)
WAWU ID register enforces email/phone uniqueness (auth.service.ts:122-129 ConflictException) and password MinLength(8)

searched: grep -rniE 'bvn|nin|dateOfBirth|selfie|liveness|nibss|nimc' in wawu-id/src + prisma/schema.prisma -> no hits; backend-routes 'bvn','kyc' -> only GET/POST /api/hub/kyc (manual submission); grep 'fintava|dojah|smile|youverify|prembly' in wawu-backend/src -> none

artboards.title: Phone code

evidence: WAWU ID POST /auth/otp/start {phone} (auth.controller.ts:42; otp.service.ts generateAndSend: 6-digit, 5-min TTL, delivered via Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, email fallback)
backend.gap: otp/verify is a phone-LOGIN: it find-or-creates a phone-only WawuUser and issues tokens (auth.service.ts:713-748); it does not mark a registering account's phone as verified - WawuUser has no phoneVerified column. Delivery is WhatsApp, not SMS. No resend throttle beyond replacing the previous code. Separately: WAWU ID login refuses accounts with an unverified email (auth.service.ts:206-213 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED), and this board path never verifies the email, so a user created this way cannot sign in on A22 later.

web.delta: Web OTP verifies the EMAIL (6-digit code emailed, POST /auth/email/verify/start|confirm), not the phone.

third_party: SMS OTP delivery (canvas says SMS; WAWU ID currently uses Meta WhatsApp Cloud API)

summary: Auth and Settings cover sign-up, sign-in, password reset, CBN-style account tiers, payout bank, and the Settings/Privacy/Delete/About/legal screens. Authentication lives in WAWU ID (/home/user/wawu-id/src), which today serves email+password register/login, refresh, email-code verification, phone OTP login, forgot/reset password and versioned policies; the Hub only mirrors profile data (accountType, interests) and owns settings, privacy, blocking and account deletion. Sign-in, forgot password and the settings/privacy/blocked screens are largely served and already built on web. The board's sign-up is a different product: BVN mandatory for everyone, NIBSS phone match, BVN-prefilled details incl. DOB, liveness selfie, an automatic Fintava MFB Tier 1 wallet for every account, and a 4-digit transaction PIN; none of BVN lookup, face match, DOB, tiers, Fintava, or PIN exists in WAWU ID, the Hub or web, and several conflict directly with current product rules (no liveness/Face-ID, manual KYC only for earning, Flutterwave custody, creator-only wallet). WAWU ID register accepts names, email, phone, country, state, gender, occupation (dropped) and password but no BVN, NIN, DOB or account type. A concrete trap: the board never verifies email, yet WAWU ID login refuses unverified-email accounts, so a board-path user could not sign back in. Highest-priority dependency for Wallet is the transaction PIN plus device/biometric binding, which have zero existing footprint. Settings gaps are smaller: change-password, server-side sign-out, three notification keys, data-export fulfilment, block enforcement in search/profile, and a 30-day cancellable deletion versus today's 48h non-cancellable one.
